card.name: Small words in step-by-step instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, by, until, and, for) right after an instruction verb or clause in procedural text, such as lab protocols, recipes and dose-adjustment steps. The next words usually give a place, method or end condition.

modes.label: until after an action
modes.description: The word until follows a hold, wait, cook or keep instruction and introduces an end condition.

modes.label: Preposition or conjunction after a step
modes.description: A short word such as in, by, and or for follows a procedural verb or clause and leads to the rest of the step.
